description: The training program prepared GPs to learn the indications for FLUS, execute the validated 14-zone FLUS protocol, and interpret findings.
title: Tailored three-component FLUS training program for general practitioners (theoretical self-study with validated MCQ test, one-day hands-on course with LUS-OSAUS assessment, and supervised real-life scans)

description: A lesson-level design in which the outcomes of a science unit are mapped onto a sequence of game-based physical activities, integrated \"from simple to complex\" across five weeks.
title: Game-based physical activity plans integrating science outcomes from simple to complex across a five-week unit

description: A prerequisite knowledge graph extracted by GPT-4 from 26 lesson PDFs of a graduate-level AI course, following a three-stage protocol of topic extraction, boundary consolidation, and edge extraction.
title: GPT-4-extracted curriculum prerequisite knowledge graph (54 topic nodes, 47 directed prerequisite edges)

description: A proprietary educational AI chatbot combining GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet in a multi-layered architecture, used as the experimental training tool in the pilot RCT.
title: Multi-layered GPT-4o/Claude 3.5 Sonnet OSCE simulation chatbot with automated scoring and text feedback
